memory_tip: majest(威严)+-ic：雄伟的即 majestic。

etymology: from Old English macian 'to make, form'.
memory_tip: make 古义'做/造'：制作即 make。

examples: He is in the making of a leader.
The making of the film took a year.
memory_tip: make(做)+-ing：制作/形成即 making。
mal(坏,如 male)+aria(空气)：疟疾(旧称瘴气)即 malaria。

examples: The remark was full of malice.
memory_tip: mal(坏)+-ice：恶意即 malice。

etymology: from Old French mal 'a place for games', later Pall Mall (a ball game).

similar.description: mall = shopping centre; maul = to injure.

memory_tip: mall 源自球戏场：购物中心即 mall。
malle(锤,如 mallet)+-able：可锻/易影响的即 malleable。
mal(坏)+nutrition(营养)：营养不良即 malnutrition。

examples: The doctor was sued for malpractice.
memory_tip: mal(坏)+practice(执业)：渎职/不当行医即 malpractice。
man(手,如 manual)+-acle：手铐即 manacle。
manager(管理)+-ial：管理(层)的即 managerial。

examples: The law has a clear mandate.
memory_tip: man(手)+date(给)：授权/命令即 mandate。

examples: The test is mandatory for all.
memory_tip: mandat(命令)+-ory：强制的即 mandatory。

etymology: from Spanish manglar, from Portuguese mangue, from Taino.
memory_tip: mang(红树,泰诺语)+rove：红树林即 mangrove。

examples: A manhole leads to the sewer.
etymology: from man + hole (an access hole for a person).
memory_tip: man(人)+hole(洞)：检修孔即 manhole。

examples: A maniac laughed in the film.
memory_tip: man(狂,如 mania)+-iac：疯子即 maniac。

examples: This is a manifestation of stress.

similar.description: vs manifestation vs manifestation vs manifesto; confusable.

memory_tip: manifest(明显)+-ation：表现/显现即 manifestation。
mani(多,如 many)+fold(重)：多方面的即 manifold。

examples: Manila is the capital of the Philippines.
The letter was on Manila paper.
etymology: from Manila, Philippines; 'Manila paper' named after the city.
memory_tip: Manila 马尼拉：马尼拉纸/首都即 Manila。
manner(举止)+-ism：习气/怪癖即 mannerism。

examples: The old mansion stood on a hill.
memory_tip: mans(住,如 remain)+-ion：豪宅即 mansion。

examples: Snow covered the hills like a mantle.
He took up the mantle of leader.
etymology: from Old English mantel, from Latin mantellum 'cloak'.
memory_tip: mant(披风,拉丁)+-le：披风/覆盖物即 mantle。

etymology: from Old French manouvrer 'to cultivate' (manus 'hand' + operari 'work').
memory_tip: man(手)+ure(劳作)：肥料(源自耕作)即 manure。

etymology: from Old English merran 'to hinder, spoil'.
memory_tip: mar 古英语'毁损'：破坏即 mar。

etymology: from French marchier 'to walk', of Germanic origin.
memory_tip: march 源自'行走'：行进/游行即 march。

examples: The country has a maritime climate.

similar.description: vs martial; confusable (maritime = sea, martial = war).

memory_tip: mar(海,如 marine)+-itime：海洋的即 maritime。

examples: The marrow of the issue was clear.
memory_tip: marrow 古英语'髓'：骨髓/精髓即 marrow。
marsh 古英语'湿地'：沼泽即 marsh。

examples: A martial tone filled the speech.
memory_tip: mart(战,如 Mars 战神)+-ial：军事的即 martial。

examples: The martyr died for his faith.
She was a martyr to the cause.
memory_tip: martyr 希腊语'见证者'：殉道者即 martyr。
marvel 源自'mirare 惊奇'：奇迹/惊叹即 marvel。
mascul(男,如 male)+-inity：男子气概即 masculinity。
masque(面具)+rade：化装舞会/伪装即 masquerade。

etymology: two senses: from Old English gemæcca 'companion/equal' and Old French mèche 'wick'.

similar.description: match = either a light or an equal/counterpart.

memory_tip: match 双源：火柴/匹配，均表'对应'即 match。
mater(母,如 mother)+-nal：母亲的即 maternal。
matric(名册)+-ulate：注册入学即 matriculate。
matri(母,如 maternal)+mony：婚姻即 matrimony。
maxim(最大)+-ize：最大化即 maximize。

etymology: from Old French maigre, from Latin macer 'lean'.
memory_tip: meagre 源自拉丁'macer 瘦'：贫乏的即 meagre。

examples: Don't be so mean to her.
etymology: from Old English mænan 'to intend, say'; the 'average' and 'stingy' senses are separate developments.

similar.description: mean has several senses: intend, average, stingy.

memory_tip: mean 多义：意为/平均/吝啬，古义'意指'即 mean。

examples: Do not meddle in their affair.
etymology: from Old French medler 'to mix' (Latin miscere 'to mix').

similar.description: meddle vs middle; related to mixing.

memory_tip: med(混,如 mix)+-dle：干涉即 meddle。
medi(中,如 medium)+-ate：调解即 mediate。

similar.description: medication = a drug; medicine = the field/drug.

memory_tip: medic(医,如 medical)+-ation：药物即 medication。

etymology: from Latin mediocris 'of middle height/quality' (medius 'middle' + ocris 'rugged mountain').
memory_tip: medi(中)+ocre(山)：中庸的/平庸的即 mediocre。
meek 古诺尔斯语'柔和'：温顺的即 meek。
melan(黑,如 melanin)+choly(胆汁)：忧郁(黑胆汁)即 melancholy。
melod(旋律,如 melody)+-ious：悦耳的即 melodious。
membr(成员/肢体,如 member)+-ane：膜即 membrane。

examples: He kept the coin as a memento.
The photo is a memento of the trip.
memory_tip: mement(记住,如 memory)+-o：纪念品即 memento。

etymology: from Latin memorandum 'things to be remembered' (memor 'mindful').

similar.description: memo is the short form of memorandum.

memory_tip: memor(记忆)+and(须)+-um：备忘录即 memorandum。
ment(心,如 mind)+-ality：心态即 mentality。

examples: No mention was made of it.
etymology: from Latin mentionem (mens 'mind', a calling to mind).
memory_tip: ment(心,如 mental)+-ion：提及即 mention。

etymology: from Italian mercantile (mercante 'merchant', from Latin mercari 'to trade').
memory_tip: merc(商,如 merchant)+-antile：商业的即 mercantile。
